status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.
status.longComment: Holiday is dealing with an undisclosed injury, and he did not play during the preseason. The wide receiver will now be forced to miss the entire 2026 campaign while on IR, unless he is able to reach an injury settlement with Kansas City.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Jones (calf) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday.
status.longComment: Jones was able to play through the tension in his calf in Monday's win versus the Broncos, so it's unlikely his availability for Week 2 is in any true jeopardy. A full practice Thursday or Friday would clear up any lingering doubt going into the weekend.

status.label: PUP
status.shortComment: Norman-Lott (knee) was moved to the reserve/PUP list by the Chiefs on Sunday.
status.longComment: Norman-Lott was placed on the active/PUP list ahead of training camp, and he did not appear in a preseason game as he continues to recover from a torn ACL that he suffered in October. The defensive lineman will now be forced to miss at least four contests to begin the regular season, and in his absence, rookie first-rounder Peter Woods will handle the primary reserve role at defensive tackle behind Chris Jones and Khyiris Tonga.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Chiefs placed McDonald (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: McDonald will now be forced to miss at least four games after sustaining a knee injury during Monday's win over the Broncos. Ashton Gillotte, R Mason Thomas and Jack Pyburn should be in line for increased playing time in McDonald's absence.
